title: Buyer’s Bankruptcy Risk, Sourcing Strategy, and Firm Value: Evidence from the Supplier Protection Act
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD. Post2004 (fiscal years after the 2005 Supplier Protection Act) is interacted with a pre-2004 Z-score below 1.81 (time-invariant distress group), in a firm-year panel for 2003-2006 estimated with xtreg fe. All treated firms switch on at the same date. Every column includes lagged time-varying controls (size, leverage, Tobin's Q, profitability, tangibility, lagged Z-score indicator) and/or time-varying size-bin dummies. No data shipped.
design_notes: code_supply_chain.do: xtreg <outcome> Post2004_Pre04ZscoreBelow181 Post2004 LZscoreBelow181 <controls> if fyear>=2003 & fyear<=2006 & (Pre04ZscoreAbove3==1 | Pre04ZscoreBelow181==1), fe; outcomes NumGoodSupplier_tier1, inventory, payables, sales, profit, firm value, PD, covenant violations, Chapter 11.
